templates.cert16-octt-strictness-probe.d: Emulate legacy OCTT strictness: RSA-only CSR, CRLF PEM, RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5-only certificate acceptance, hidden CpoName, and compatibility warnings for automatic GetConfiguration/GetDiagnostics after connect (promoted to failures in strict mode).
templates.cert16-reservation-basic.name: Cert 1.6 Core: Reservation (Basic)
templates.cert16-reservation-basic.descr: Parks waiting for ReserveNow.req (the CP core emits StatusNotification(Reserved) on Accepted); once the reserved idTag is presented, StatusNotification(Preparing) → StartTransaction.req (carries the reservationId) → StatusNotification(Charging) with bounded MeterValues.req → StopTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Finishing) → StatusNotification(Available).
templates.cert16-tc001-cold-boot.name: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_001 Cold Boot
templates.cert16-tc001-cold-boot.descrip: BootNotification.req/.conf runs automatically on connect; the CP core drives every idle connector to Available and sends StatusNotification(Available) on boot, so this scenario just observes that boot behavior and idles while the CP's own Heartbeat timer keeps running.
templates.cert16-tc003-charging-plugin-f: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_003 Charging Session (Plug-In First)

Plug-in → StatusNotification(Preparing); idTag presented → StartTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Charging); bounded MeterValues.req while charging; StopTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Finishing) → StatusNotification(Available).
templates.cert16-tc004-charging-id-first: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_004 Charging Session (Identification First)

idTag presented before the cable is connected: StatusNotification(Preparing) is entered on identification rather than plug-in, then StartTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Charging); bounded MeterValues.req while charging; StopTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Finishing) → StatusNotification(Available).
templates.cert16-tc005-ev-side-disconnec: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_005 EV Side Disconnected

Plug-in → StatusNotification(Preparing) → StartTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Charging); bounded MeterValues.req; EV-side disconnect (plugout) → StopTransaction.req with EVDisconnected reason → StatusNotification(Finishing, Available). The plugout stops the transaction itself while StopTransactionOnEVSideDisconnect=true (the default); with false it reports SuspendedEV and the Stop Transaction node ends it with EVDisconnected.
templates.cert16-tc010-remote-start.name: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_010 Remote Start Transaction
templates.cert16-tc010-remote-start.desc: Plug in → StatusNotification(Preparing); CSMS sends RemoteStartTransaction → CP starts transaction with tag from request → StatusNotification(Charging); bounded MeterValues.req while charging.
templates.cert16-tc011-remote-start-stop: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_011 Remote Start + Remote Stop Transaction

RemoteStartTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Preparing) → StartTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Charging) with running MeterValues.req; on RemoteStopTransaction.req, StopTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Finishing) → StatusNotification(Available).
templates.cert16-tc012-remote-stop.name: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_012 Remote Stop Transaction
templates.cert16-tc012-remote-stop.descr: Locally-started session (StartTransaction.req + running MeterValues.req) already Charging when RemoteStopTransaction.req arrives; StopTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Finishing) → StatusNotification(Available).
templates.cert16-tc013-hard-reset.name: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_013 Hard Reset
templates.cert16-tc013-hard-reset.descri: Plug-in → StatusNotification(Preparing) → StartTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Charging); unbounded MeterValues.req; operator sends Reset(type=Hard) from CSMS, CP stops transaction with HardReset reason and reboots.
templates.cert16-tc014-soft-reset.name: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_014 Soft Reset
templates.cert16-tc014-soft-reset.descri: Plug-in → StatusNotification(Preparing) → StartTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Charging); unbounded MeterValues.req; operator sends Reset(type=Soft) from CSMS, CP stops transaction with SoftReset reason and reboots.
templates.cert16-tc017-unlock-occupied.n: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_017 Unlock Connector (Occupied, Succeeds)
templates.cert16-tc017-unlock-occupied.d: Session running (StartTransaction.req, Charging, MeterValues.req); pre-arms the connector's next UnlockConnector.req response as Unlocked so the CSMS can verify a successful remote unlock while occupied, then StopTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Finishing) → StatusNotification(Available).
templates.cert16-tc018-unlock-failure.de: Session running (StartTransaction.req, Charging, MeterValues.req); pre-arms the connector's next UnlockConnector.req response as UnlockFailed so the CSMS can verify the failure path (e.g. stuck lock), then the session ends normally via StopTransaction.req → StatusNotification(Finishing) → StatusNotification(Available).
templates.cert16-tc019-get-configuration: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_019_1 Retrieve All Configuration Keys
CSMS sends GetConfiguration with no key filter. CP retrieves and returns all configuration keys from its store.
Cert 1.6 Core: TC_019_2 Retrieve Specific Configuration Key
CSMS sends GetConfiguration requesting a specific key (e.g., HeartbeatInterval). CP retrieves and returns the requested configuration value.
templates.cert16-tc021-change-configurat: CSMS sends ChangeConfiguration to update a configuration key (e.g., MeterValueSampleInterval). The CP answers per its configuration store — Accepted, Rejected, RebootRequired, or NotSupported depending on the key — and the operator can verify the change was applied via GetConfiguration.
templates.cert16-tc023-1-authorize-inval: Operator ensures idTag CERT023-INV is unknown to the CSMS. Plug in; CP sends Authorize.req before starting a transaction (issue #181); CSMS responds Invalid; CP does not send StartTransaction.req and the scenario continues to plug-out.
templates.cert16-tc023-2-authorize-expir: Operator ensures idTag CERT023-EXP is registered on the CSMS with an expiry_date in the past. Plug in; CP sends Authorize.req before starting a transaction (issue #181); CSMS responds Expired; CP does not send StartTransaction.req and the scenario continues to plug-out.
templates.cert16-tc023-3-authorize-block: Operator ensures idTag CERT023-BLK is registered on the CSMS as blocked. Plug in; CP sends Authorize.req before starting a transaction (issue #181); CSMS responds Blocked; CP does not send StartTransaction.req and the scenario continues to plug-out.
templates.cert16-tc024-lock-failure.name: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_024 Start Charging Session — Lock Failure
templates.cert16-tc024-lock-failure.desc: Plug-in; delay 2s; StatusNotification(Faulted, ConnectorLockFailure, no transaction started); delay 2s; plug-out → StatusNotification(Available).
templates.cert16-tc026-remote-start-reje: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_026 Remote Start — Rejected
Connector Available; CSMS sends RemoteStartTransaction.req; CP responds with Rejected status; no transaction starts.
templates.cert16-tc028-remote-stop-rejec: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_028 Remote Stop — Rejected
Plug-in → Preparing → StartTransaction → Charging with auto-meter; CSMS sends RemoteStopTransaction.req; CP responds with Rejected status; charging continues; Local stop after delay.
templates.cert16-tc031-unlock-unknown-co: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_031 Unlock Connector — Unknown Connector
CSMS sends UnlockConnector for a non-existent connector ID. CP returns NotSupported per §7.46 errata 3.87.
templates.cert16-tc042-1-get-local-list-: Cert 1.6 LocalList: TC_042_1 Get Local List Version — Not Supported
Local list disabled via configuration; CSMS sends GetLocalListVersion; CP returns listVersion -1.
templates.cert16-tc042-2-get-local-list-: Cert 1.6 LocalList: TC_042_2 Get Local List Version — Empty List
Local list enabled; CSMS sends GetLocalListVersion; fresh CP returns listVersion 0.
templates.cert16-tc043-1-send-local-list: Cert 1.6 LocalList: TC_043_1 Send Local List — NotSupported
Local list disabled via configuration; CSMS sends SendLocalList; CP returns NotSupported status.
templates.cert16-tc043-3-send-local-list: Cert 1.6 LocalList: TC_043_3 Send Local List — Failed
Local list enabled; CSMS sends SendLocalList; CP responds with Failed status via pre-armed response override.
templates.cert16-tc043-4-send-local-list: Cert 1.6 LocalList: TC_043_4 Send Local List — Full Update
Local list enabled; CSMS sends SendLocalList with Full updateType; CP stores the list and bumps its version.
templates.cert16-tc043-5-send-local-list: Cert 1.6 LocalList: TC_043_5 Send Local List — Differential Update
Local list enabled; CSMS sends SendLocalList with Full, then Differential updateType; CP processes both and updates the list version.
templates.cert16-tc044-1-firmware-update: Cert 1.6 Firmware: TC_044_1 Firmware Update — Download and Install

CSMS sends UpdateFirmware.req with a retrieveDate in the near past; the CP progresses through FirmwareStatusNotification states Downloading → Downloaded → Installing → Installed (simulated at 2-second intervals, ~6 seconds total sequence). BootNotification is not re-sent at completion.
templates.cert16-tc044-2-firmware-downlo: Cert 1.6 Firmware: TC_044_2 Firmware Update — Download Failed

Pre-arms the CP via the custom `SimulatedFirmwareUpdateFailure` config key (set to 'DownloadFailed' through a local configSet step) so the simulated firmware train diverts after Downloading: CSMS sends UpdateFirmware.req with a retrieveDate in the near past; the CP sends FirmwareStatusNotification(Downloading) then FirmwareStatusNotification(DownloadFailed) and stops — Installing/Installed are never reached. The arm applies to the next UpdateFirmware only and clears itself automatically.
templates.cert16-tc044-3-firmware-instal: Cert 1.6 Firmware: TC_044_3 Firmware Update — Installation Failed

Pre-arms the CP via the custom `SimulatedFirmwareUpdateFailure` config key (set to 'InstallationFailed' through a local configSet step) so the simulated firmware train diverts after Installing: CSMS sends UpdateFirmware.req with a retrieveDate in the near past; the CP progresses through FirmwareStatusNotification states Downloading → Downloaded → Installing, then sends FirmwareStatusNotification(InstallationFailed) instead of Installed. The arm applies to the next UpdateFirmware only and clears itself automatically.
templates.cert16-tc045-1-get-diagnostics: CSMS sends GetDiagnostics.req with an upload location; CP responds with fileName 'diagnostics.txt' and sends DiagnosticsStatusNotification (Uploading, then Uploaded on successful POST to the location, or UploadFailed if the location is unreachable or returns non-2xx HTTP status — both outcomes are certification-relevant). If the upload is slow, status notifications may continue to arrive after the scenario itself has ended.
templates.cert16-tc048-1-reserve-now-fau: Cert 1.6 Reservation: TC_048_1 Reserve Now — Faulted
Connector set to Faulted with errorCode InternalError; CSMS sends ReserveNow; CP responds with Faulted status via pre-armed response override; reset to Available.
templates.cert16-tc048-2-reserve-now-occ: Cert 1.6 Reservation: TC_048_2 Reserve Now — Occupied
Plug-in; set status Preparing; arm Occupied response override; CSMS sends ReserveNow; CP responds with Occupied status; plug-out; reset to Available.
templates.cert16-tc048-3-reserve-now-una: Cert 1.6 Reservation: TC_048_3 Reserve Now — Unavailable
Connector set to Unavailable; arm Unavailable response override; CSMS sends ReserveNow; CP responds with Unavailable status; reset to Available.
templates.cert16-tc048-4-reserve-now-rej: Cert 1.6 Reservation: TC_048_4 Reserve Now — Rejected
Connector Available; CP configured to not accept reservations; CSMS sends ReserveNow; CP responds with Rejected status via pre-armed response override.
templates.cert16-tc051-cancel-reservatio: Connector Available; CSMS sends ReserveNow (connector transitions Reserved internally); scenario waits for the reservation, then for CancelReservation.req from the CSMS; CP core flips Reserved → Available; statusTrigger confirms.
templates.cert16-tc052-cancel-reservatio: Cert 1.6 Reservation: TC_052 Cancel Reservation — Rejected

Connector Available; CSMS sends CancelReservation with a reservationId that does not exist; CP core CancelReservationHandler (packages/core/src/cp/infrastructure/transport/handlers/call/ReservationHandlers.ts:103) answers Rejected; no override needed.
templates.cert16-tc054-trigger-message.d: CSMS sends TriggerMessage requesting a message type (e.g. StatusNotification, Heartbeat, MeterValues, BootNotification, DiagnosticsStatusNotification, FirmwareStatusNotification). CP answers Accepted and sends the requested message. Re-run the scenario to try further message kinds.
templates.cert16-tc055-trigger-message-r: Cert 1.6 RemoteTrigger: TC_055 Trigger Message — Rejected
CSMS sends TriggerMessage. The pre-armed CP answers Rejected and sends nothing.
templates.cert16-tc056-central-smart-cha: Cert 1.6 SmartCharging: TC_056 Central Smart Charging — TxDefaultProfile

Charging session runs with a live transaction; CSMS sends SetChargingProfile with a TxDefaultProfile for connector 1. CP validates and stores the profile and applies the schedule (Charging/SuspendedEVSE may toggle while a zero-limit period is active), then the scenario stops the transaction and returns to Available.
templates.cert16-tc057-central-smart-cha: Cert 1.6 SmartCharging: TC_057 Central Smart Charging — TxProfile

Charging session runs with a live transaction; CSMS sends SetChargingProfile with a TxProfile for the running transaction on connector 1. CP validates and stores the profile and applies the schedule, then the scenario stops the transaction and returns to Available.
templates.cert16-tc059-remote-start-with: Cert 1.6 SmartCharging: TC_059 Remote Start with Charging Profile

CSMS sends RemoteStartTransaction with attached ChargingProfile. CP accepts the request and starts the transaction (per §5.11, a CP without Smart Charging may ignore the profile) but does not store or apply the attached profile.
templates.cert16-tc061-clear-cache.name: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_061 Clear Authorization Cache
templates.cert16-tc061-clear-cache.descr: CSMS sends ClearCache. CP empties its Authorization Cache (§5.4) and confirms Accepted, also while AuthorizationCacheEnabled is false.
templates.cert16-tc064-data-transfer.nam: Cert 1.6 Core: TC_064 Data Transfer to Central System
templates.cert16-tc064-data-transfer.des: CP sends DataTransfer.req (§4.3) with vendorId com.example.cert16 and test payload. CSMS response status (Accepted or UnknownVendorId) is tested on the CSMS side.
templates.cert16-tc066-get-composite-sch: Cert 1.6 SmartCharging: TC_066 Get Composite Schedule
Parks on SetChargingProfile, then on GetCompositeSchedule (two sequential csmsCallTrigger parks testing re-park path)
templates.cert16-tc067-clear-charging-pr: Cert 1.6 SmartCharging: TC_067 Clear Charging Profile
CSMS sends SetChargingProfile; CP stores it. Then CSMS sends ClearChargingProfile; CP clears the stored profile and confirms Accepted.
templates.essential-cp-behavior.name: Essential CP Behavior
templates.essential-cp-behavior.descript: Auto-start on connect: plug in, wait for RemoteStart, run a transaction with auto-meter (stops at the EV's target SoC), then plug out.
templates.full-charging-cycle.name: Full Charging Cycle
templates.multi-status-monitor.name: Multi-Status Monitor (Parallel)
templates.multi-status-monitor.descripti: Monitor multiple statuses in parallel and execute different actions
templates.remote-start-auto-meter.name: Remote Start + Auto MeterValue
templates.resilience-authorization-rejec: Operator-prepared: the idTag RESIL-BLK must be Blocked on the CSMS. Plugs in, tries to start with it, and passes when Authorize was answered Blocked, no transaction started, and the connector is Available again after the cable was pulled (the run waits for it; OCPP 1.6 shape for the idTagInfo check).
templates.resilience-communication-loss-: Operator-driven. Cut the connection (network_sim.disconnect.trigger with a manual-disconnect rule, or any socket drop) while the connector is Available. The run waits for the drop and the reconnect, then for Available, then sends a DataTransfer probe (vendorId org.ocpp-cp-sim.resilience, messageId link-probe) and passes when the probe went out over the recovered link. It does not assert a BootNotification: OCPP-J says a station SHOULD NOT send one when it reconnects unless its boot data changed, so whether one follows depends on the OCPP version and settings. Version-agnostic.
templates.resilience-connector-fault-rec: Self-contained (OCPP 1.6 payload checks). Reports a Faulted connector with errorCode GroundFailure, holds it for 3 s, clears it with Available/NoError, and passes when both StatusNotifications were sent in that order.
templates.resilience-ev-disconnect-recov: Self-contained (OCPP 1.6 payload checks). Starts a session, pulls the cable mid-charge and passes when the transaction stopped with reason EVDisconnected (StopTransactionOnEVSideDisconnect=true, 1.6 §4.10) and the connector came back to Available.
templates.resilience-power-loss-recovery: Operator-driven, uses the power-loss primitive (#455). Plugs in and starts a session; then trigger power.loss (the transaction survives it) and power.restore (or power.loss with restoreAfterMs). Passes when the charge point booted again after the loss and reported its connector status. What happens to the transaction depends on the recovery chosen (resume, or end with PowerLoss; docs/concepts/charging-sessions.md), so the verdict does not depend on it.
templates.resilience-temporary-unavailab: Operator-driven. Send ChangeAvailability(Inoperative) then ChangeAvailability(Operative) for the connector. Passes when both calls arrived and the connector reported Unavailable and then Available (OCPP 1.6 payload checks for the statuses).
templates.smart-charging.name: Smart Charging (Auto MeterValue)
templates.smart-charging.description: Auto-increment MeterValue when Charging, stop when Finishing
templates.status-triggered-actions.name: Status-Triggered Auto Actions
templates.status-triggered-actions.descr: Auto-execute on status change (Heartbeat loop when Available)
